■ Direction

You've been far too picky with food since childhood.
Listen, the sheer amount of energy we consume is—

No, wait, Brian.
Have you... gotten too thin?

A clear, crisp voice echoed from above. Looking up,
I saw an Umamusume leaning out of a classroom window.

And in tomorrow's 10th race,
my name—Biwa Hayahide—is on the card.

I knew it! The "Monster," Narita Brian...!
I heard she was hard to track down, but to run into her here!

Tomorrow was the "Selection Race"... the day when Umamusume aiming
to debut prove their abilities to trainers in hopes of getting scouted.

Just as promised, Biwa Hayahide had put on
a flawless, masterclass race...!

The lead pack enters the curve at the 3rd corner!
It's a fierce battle up front!
...Very well, let me make one declaration.
You there! I apologize, are you unhurt?

Hey, isn't this my chance to scout her...!
Brian! Please, hear me out—!!
I have something I must accomplish on the Twinkle Series turf.

Intrigued, I went to watch the Selection Race the following day.
And there, she—
I shall cross the wire in 1st place by ten lengths or more.

Huh...? 
H-Hey! Isn't that girl...!!
You have my thanks. ...Thanks to you, tomorrow won't be hindered in the slightest.
Past the final corner, pulling out to the outside—
Naturally, I intend to seize it... my debut opportunity, that is.
Honestly... what a handful.

Ah!
My deepest apologies, I was lost in thought and suddenly—

Biwa Hayahide had shown awe-inspiring capability.
One would expect the scouting afterwards to be hers alone, but...
I was just passing by.

Turning into the final straight from the 4th corner! Biwa Hayahide on the outside!
Biwa Hayahide takes the lead! She's two lengths, three lengths clear!

Yes. —Judging by the badge on your lapel, you're a trainer too, correct?
If so, you must already be aware.
—Now, shall we begin?!
...Shut up. I'm eating.

An unyielding resolve seeped through her measured tone. As I found myself
staring into the quiet fire behind her lenses—she continued.

I want to know more about her.
From the bottom of my heart, that's what I felt.

A racer who runs purely on high-level theory,
with a "Monster" for a younger sister—Biwa Hayahide.

Mm... Frame articulation is intact,
and no scratches detected on the lenses.

She loves logic and theory.
And yet—our encounter felt almost entirely driven by intuition.

Ah, wait up, Brian!
With your talent, the Triple Crown is guaranteed! Please, team up with—!!
Gaaah! Sis, you overthink every single little thing!
Oh, Brian. You came to watch?

Tch, too noisy...
See ya, Sis.

Therefore, falling from a mere second-story height
should theoretically cause no damage whatsoever, but—
...All proceeding according to calculations.

They could just as easily have been crushed underfoot by a runner below.
You are the one who brought that probability down to zero.
...Are you sure? You have my gratitude!

These glasses are custom-built to withstand actual races, you see.
Naturally, the materials were chosen to endure considerable impact.

Hmm... I see. Don't tell me you dislike
the cafeteria's recently revamped menu?
...It seems my theory still has room for refinement.

How is your dietary management being handled?
Could you be suffering from a nutritional deficit?

What?! M-My head is not big!
It is completely standard size... Brian!!

Fierce jostling for the lead right from the break!
The center of attention, Biwa Hayahide, settles into a prime tracking position!

In tomorrow's race, I shall maintain a forward position until the final corner.
The lead pack will undoubtedly be bunched together tightly.
One day, while passing behind the school building—

Something fell from above.
Catching the evening sun with a bright glint, it was—
...Good work.

And so, I went to return the glasses I'd caught
to the Umamusume waiting in the classroom—Biwa Hayahide.

Biwa Hayahide crosses the line in 1st place!
An overwhelming, runaway victory!!!

Man, that was magnificent, Biwa Hayahide!
To show that kind of composure, it's as if everything was preordained—

Biwa Hayahide's "theory"—composed yet burning with passion.
Just what kind of results would it lead us to—?

That is the theoretical outcome I have calculated.
As for what truly transpires... please, verify it tomorrow with your own eyes.
